en.title: Advocacy Group Condemns Metrolinx's Inaccessible Finch West LRT Ramp and Missing Elevator
en.summary: An accessibility advocacy group condemned Metrolinx for a poorly designed ramp and missing elevator at the Finch West LRT station, calling it inadequate for wheelchair users. In other news, a volunteer-led Joomla CMS project secured Sovereign Tech Fund funding to expand its accessibility initiatives, and Washington County donated an accessible school bus with wheelchair lifts to Marietta City Schools. Additionally, the 2026 Boat Show is seeking experiences and solutions for accessibility improvements via a new survey, while a guide outlines best practices for writing meaningful image alt text.

zh-TW.title: 無障礙團體譴責Metrolinx Finch West LRT斜坡設計缺電梯
zh-TW.summary: 無障礙倡導團體譴責Metrolinx在Finch West LRT站的斜坡設計不佳且缺少電梯，對輪椅使用者構成障礙。同時，志願者領導的Joomla CMS項目獲得主權科技基金資助以擴展無障礙功能，華盛頓縣發展障礙委員會捐贈無障礙校車給瑪麗埃塔市學校。此外，2026年船展正徵求經驗與解決方案以改善無障礙設施，而一則推文指出Amida Care與NAMI合作提升心理健康服務的可及性。
